identity: The Arabic Wikipedia article on Manchester City F.C.: lead paragraph, honours summary, the modern era to 2023, then two heading lines (al-tarikh, fatrat al-nushu) and two history paragraphs covering 1899-1956. Seven printed lines, two of which are bare headings.
law: ENCYCLOPEDIC PROSE (section A), EDITED, but with an unusually ASYNDETIC style: most sentences here simply start with a perfect verb and no connective (assasa / atlaqa / intaqala / faza / irtaqa / hadatha / haza / tabia / shahida / yahtall). 677 real tokens / 42 units = 16.3 per unit, the edited-prose figure. Heading lines are their own units (M2).
reasoning: Because the style is asyndetic, most boundaries are free: the sentence break IS the absence of a connective, and I took every one of them. The judgement went into the fronted frames and the connectives. Fronted date/place frames open their unit and take the cut BEFORE them, never after (0n/0x): @161 before wa-bad dhalik, @214 before wa-fi am 2014, @278 before fi mawsim 2018-19, @453 before fi al-mawsim al-tali, @538 before khilal kas al-ittihad, @593 before fi al-jawla al-sadisa, @637 before wa-bad ishrin aman, and @438 before amma fi al-kas. Connectives: I cut at f + a new finite verb (@119 fa-faza) and at w + kana as a fresh nominal statement (@222 wa-l-laqab al-thani li-l-sana kana, @424 wa-l-laqab kana), which is 1j; I refused wa-dhalika (@130, anaphoric, 0q), wa-lakinnahu/wa-lakin (@340, @621 - both immediate counter-outcomes, 1q), thumma repeating the same act of naming (@30, 0u/1w), and the masdar conjuncts wa-tahqiq (@358) and wa-l-istithmar (@176). Two calls I am least sure of, both marked lo. (a) @255 before KAMA ihtalla al-martaba al-sadisa: 0q demotes kama to no-cut, but the two ranking sentences are 27 and 23 tokens and reading them as one 50-token unit is far outside anything gold produces, so I treated this kama as a sentence-opener meaning also rather than as the subordinator kama = as. (b) @467 splits wa-qad lahaqat al-nadi ittihamat bi-mukhalafat maliyya from wa-balaghat dhurwat iqaf al-laibin - one topic, two finite verbs, and I cut on 1j rather than leave a 33-token unit. Note the source has two typos I did not let disturb the count: malab malab duplicated at @63-@64 and dhurwat for dhurwataha at @469.
